claims.claim_text: RA 9266 IRR Section 3(18) states that architectural documents are outputs only an architect can sign and seal.
RA 9266 IRR Section 3(26) lists the usual contract-document package components.
UAP Document 301 supports the complementary reading and coordination of drawings and specifications.
